description: This file defines a Java interface named MatriculaRepository which extends JpaRepository to manage Matricula entities in the context of a Spring Data JPA application. It declares methods to find enrollment records (Matricula) by course and user.

classes.name: MatriculaRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for managing Matricula entities with custom finder methods.

methods.name: findAllByCurso
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Matricula entries associated with a specific Curso.

methods.name: findAllByUsuario
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Matricula entries associated with a specific User.

methods.name: findByCursoAndUsuario
methods.description: Finds a specific Matricula entry matching both a Curso and a User.
